description:
This process begins when an employee or customer reports an incident, such as a technical issue or workplace safety concern.
The report is logged into a tracking system and assigned to the appropriate team for investigation.
The team gathers necessary information, identifies the cause of the incident, and proposes corrective actions.
The solution is implemented, whether it's a fix, training, or policy change.
After the incident is resolved, a follow-up occurs to ensure that the issue won't recur.
The process ends when the incident report is closed, and all stakeholders are notified.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Incident"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/incident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IncidentReport" name="Incident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IncidentNotification" name="Incident notification"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Incident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Reporter" name="Employee or customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IncidentProcess" name="Incident management" processRef="Process_Incident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stakeholders" name="Stakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_IncidentReport" name="Incident report" sourceRef="Participant_Reporter" targetRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_IncidentNotification" name="Incident notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="Participant_Stakeholders" messageRef="Message_IncidentNotification"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Incident" name="Incident management process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReportReceived" name="Incident report received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Log</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReportReceived" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogReport" name="Log incident report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Log</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Log_Assign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign appropriate team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Log_Assign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assign_Gather</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather necessary information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assign_Gather</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gather_Identify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCause" name="Identify cause">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gather_Identify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_Propose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeActions" name="Propose corrective actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_Propose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Propose_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution (fix, training, or policy change)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Propose_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_FollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Follow up to ensure the issue will not recur">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_FollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUp_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete closure and notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUp_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Close</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Close</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Close_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders" messageRef="Message_IncidentNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin" name="Closure and notification complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Close_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentComplete" name="Incident process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Log" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived" targetRef="Task_LogReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogReport" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Gather" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Identify" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Propose" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Propose_Implement" sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_Split" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Close" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Notify" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_Join" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Join" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
